summary: At its meeting on February 8, 2018 the Toronto Film, Television and Digital Media Board considered item FB16.1 on Options for Film Studio Infrastructure - Initial Results.
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request Waterfront Toronto and CreateTO to fully participate in the successful relocation of production space from the properties they own, in order to make way for the upcoming Riverworks and development of Villiers Island. 2. City Council request the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to provide a further update report to the April 13, 2018 Economic Development Committee meeting on the results of the Option for Film Studio Infrastructure report by N. Barry Lyon Consultants.

text: At its meeting on February 8, 2018 the Toronto Film, Television and Digital Media Board considered item FB16.1 on Options for Film Studio Infrastructure - Initial Results.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council request Waterfront Toronto and CreateTO to fully participate in the successful relocation of production space from the properties they own, in order to make way for the upcoming Riverworks and development of Villiers Island. 2. City Council request the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to provide a further update report to the April 13, 2018 Economic Development Committee meeting on the results of the Option for Film Studio Infrastructure report by N. Barry Lyon Consultants.
